#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds an optimized native binary at ./app using only the OCaml compiler.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
build_dir=_build
rm -rf "$build_dir"
mkdir -p "$build_dir"
cp src/lru.mli src/lru.ml src/main.ml "$build_dir"/
(
  cd "$build_dir"
  flags=(-unsafe -inline 200)
  # -O3 is only accepted by flambda compilers.
  if ocamlopt -config | grep -q '^flambda: true'; then flags+=(-O3); fi
  ocamlopt "${flags[@]}" -o app lru.mli lru.ml main.ml
)
cp "$build_dir/app" ./app

(** A fixed-capacity least-recently-used cache with string keys and values.
    All operations run in O(1) expected time. *)

type t

val create : int -> t
(** [create capacity] makes an empty cache. Raises [Invalid_argument] if
    [capacity < 1]. *)

val set : t -> string -> string -> unit
(** Insert or overwrite a binding, making it the most recently used. Evicts
    the least recently used binding if the capacity is exceeded. *)

val get : t -> string -> string option
(** Look up a key; a hit makes it the most recently used. *)

val remove : t -> string -> bool
(** Remove a key, returning whether it was present. *)

val size : t -> int
